    return sum(c1 != c2 for c1, c2 in zip(s1, s2))

    """Generates all binary strings of length n."""
    return ["".join(map(str, p)) for p in product([0, 1], repeat=n)]

    """Returns the set B(x, k) of strings at Hamming distance k from x."""
